verses.arabicText: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذْ أَخْرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثَانِىَ ٱثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِى ٱلْغَارِ إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَـٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا ۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٍ لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلسُّفْلَىٰ ۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِىَ ٱلْعُلْيَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.quranTextSource: Development seed checked against Quran.com/Tanzil Uthmani-script references; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
verses.quranTextSource: Quran.com Content API v4 text_uthmani, verified 2026-09-08; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.quranTextSource: Development seed checked against Quran.com/Tanzil Uthmani-script references; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِى ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلْكَـٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.quranTextSource: Quran.com Content API v4 text_uthmani, verified 2026-09-08; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.quranTextSource: Development seed checked against Quran.com/Tanzil Uthmani-script references; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
verses.quranTextSource: Development seed checked against Quran.com/Tanzil Uthmani-script references; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.quranTextSource: Development seed checked against Quran.com/Tanzil Uthmani-script references; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.quranTextSource: Development seed checked against Quran.com/Tanzil Uthmani-script references; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ
verses.quranTextSource: Quran.com Content API v4 text_uthmani, verified 2026-09-08; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
verses.quranTextSource: Quran.com Content API v4 text_uthmani, verified 2026-09-08; formal production verification required

verses.arabicText: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدْرًۭا

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness, and prayer. Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: Keep to forgiveness (O Muhammad), and enjoin kindness, and turn away from the ignorant.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as Thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: If ye help him not, still Allah helped him when those who disbelieve drove him forth, the second of two; when they two were in the cave, when he said unto his comrade: Grieve not. Lo! Allah is with us. Then Allah caused His peace of reassurance to descend upon him and supported him with hosts ye cannot see, and made the word of those who disbelieved the nethermost, while Allah's word it was that became the uppermost. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: Those who spend (of that which Allah hath given them) in ease and in adversity, those who control their wrath and are forgiving toward mankind; Allah loveth the good;

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: Say: My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: And those who shun the worst of sins and indecencies and, when they are wroth, forgive,

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: The good deed and the evil deed are not alike. Repel the evil deed with one which is better, then lo! he, between whom and thee there was enmity (will become) as though he was a bosom friend.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!

versetranslations.source: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain
versetranslations.text: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
